NOTE: Do NOT manually edit this file. This file is automatically updated when semantic release (release.yml) runs. Manually editing this file can break your releases and break third party tools that use this file.

patches.name: Allow screenshots and screen recording
patches.description: Removes recent-apps preview hiding and screen capture restrictions across application activities.

options.title: Enable Recent App Previews
options.description: Removes android:excludeFromRecents to allow viewing the app thumbnail in the Android app switcher.

options.title: Remove Capture Restrictions
options.description: Clears screenshot and screen recording blocking flags from activities.

patches.name: Bypass root and debugger checks
patches.description: Reports the debugger as disconnected and hides root indicator files from existence checks, defeating common detection heuristics.

options.title: Bypass Debugger Checks
options.description: Force Debug.isDebuggerConnected, VMDebug.isDebuggerConnected, and waitingForDebugger to report false.

options.title: Bypass Root File Checks
options.description: Make File.exists and related probes report false inside methods that reference su, magisk, or busybox paths.

patches.name: Bypass screenshot detection
patches.description: Disables screenshot detection callbacks so the app is not notified when a screenshot is taken.

patches.name: Disable boot start-up
patches.description: Removes boot intent filters so the app cannot start itself when the device boots.

options.title: Remove Boot Intent Filters
options.description: Strip BOOT_COMPLETED, LOCKED_BOOT_COMPLETED, and quickboot intent filters from receivers and services.

patches.name: Disable tracker SDK calls
patches.description: Replaces void-returning calls into known tracking SDKs with no-op instructions so analytics, attribution, and advertising code never runs at runtime.

patches.name: Enable debugging and inspection
patches.description: Enables application debugging flags, permits cleartext traffic for proxy inspection, and strips test-only restrictions in the application manifest.

options.title: Enable Debugging
options.description: Sets android:debuggable to true on the application tag to allow attaching debuggers and profiling tools.

options.title: Allow Cleartext Traffic
options.description: Sets android:usesCleartextTraffic to true to allow inspecting HTTP/cleartext network communication.

options.title: Remove Test-Only Flag
options.description: Removes android:testOnly if present so the application can be installed normally on production devices.

patches.name: Open links in browser
patches.description: Stops http and https links from opening inside the app by removing app link verification and link intent filters.

options.title: Remove App Link Verification
options.description: Strip android:autoVerify from intent filters so the system stops opening verified links in the app.

options.title: Remove Link Intent Filters
options.description: Remove intent filters that handle http/https links entirely, so links never resolve to this app.

patches.name: Remove FLAG_SECURE
patches.description: Removes FLAG_SECURE from window flag operations so secure applications allow screenshots and screen recording.

patches.name: Strip package visibility
patches.description: Removes package visibility declarations so the app cannot enumerate other installed applications.

options.title: Remove Queries Declarations
options.description: Remove all <queries> elements used to probe for other installed packages.

options.title: Remove QUERY_ALL_PACKAGES Permission
options.description: Remove the QUERY_ALL_PACKAGES permission that grants blanket visibility of installed apps.

patches.name: Strip sensitive permissions
patches.description: Strips sensitive Android permissions (such as camera and microphone access) from the application manifest to enhance privacy.

options.title: Strip Camera
options.description: Remove camera access permissions (android.permission.CAMERA).

options.title: Strip Microphone
options.description: Remove microphone and audio recording permissions (android.permission.RECORD_AUDIO, etc.).

options.title: Strip Location
options.description: Remove location tracking permissions (ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION, ACCESS_COARSE_LOCATION, etc.).

options.title: Strip Sensors
options.description: Remove body sensor and activity recognition permissions.

options.title: Strip Contacts
options.description: Remove contacts access permissions (READ_CONTACTS, WRITE_CONTACTS, GET_ACCOUNTS).

options.title: Strip Phone & SMS
options.description: Remove phone, call log, and SMS permissions (READ_PHONE_STATE, READ_CALL_LOG, READ_SMS, SEND_SMS, etc.).

options.title: Strip Calendar
options.description: Remove calendar access permissions (READ_CALENDAR, WRITE_CALENDAR).

options.title: Strip Storage & Media
options.description: Remove media and storage permissions (READ_MEDIA_IMAGES, READ_EXTERNAL_STORAGE, etc.).

options.title: Strip Nearby Wi-Fi
options.description: Remove nearby Wi-Fi scanning permissions (NEARBY_WIFI_DEVICES, ACCESS_WIFI_STATE, CHANGE_WIFI_STATE). May affect Wi-Fi status display.

options.title: Strip Overlay Access
options.description: Remove permissions that let the app draw over other apps or change system settings (SYSTEM_ALERT_WINDOW, WRITE_SETTINGS).

options.title: Strip Special Access
options.description: Remove package installer, usage access, and all-files access permissions (REQUEST_INSTALL_PACKAGES, PACKAGE_USAGE_STATS, MANAGE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE).

patches.name: Strip trackers and telemetry
patches.description: Strips known tracking, analytics, and advertising SDK components (such as Google Analytics, Firebase, AppsFlyer, Adjust, Facebook, and Crashlytics) from the application manifest.

options.title: Strip Google & Firebase Analytics
options.description: Remove Google Analytics, Firebase Analytics, and AppMeasurement components.

options.title: Strip Facebook Analytics
options.description: Remove Facebook App Events and analytics provider components.

options.title: Strip Attribution Trackers
options.description: Remove third-party attribution and tracking SDKs (AppsFlyer, Adjust, Branch, Kochava, Mixpanel, Flurry).

options.title: Strip Crash Reporting Telemetry
options.description: Remove Crashlytics and Microsoft App Center telemetry services.

options.title: Strip Advertising ID Permissions
options.description: Remove AD_ID and AdServices permissions to prevent advertising tracking.

patches.name: Trust user certificates
patches.description: Installs a network security config that trusts user-installed CA certificates so HTTPS traffic can be inspected with proxy tools.

options.title: Trust User Certificates
options.description: Accept TLS certificates signed by user-installed certificate authorities (e.g. mitmproxy, HTTP Toolkit).

options.title: Permit Cleartext Traffic
options.description: Allow unencrypted HTTP traffic in the generated network security config.
